name: search_airports_cities
description: Search for airports and cities by name. Returns matching locations with their Google entity IDs (e.g. '/m/022pfm' for São Paulo) needed by the flight search tools.

params.name: query
params.description: City or airport name to search (e.g. 'Sao Paulo', 'Rio de Janeiro')

params.name: csrf_token
params.description: Optional: 'at' anti-CSRF token from an active Google session

name: get_flight_prices_calendar
description: Return a price calendar for a round-trip route across a date range. Use origin/destination entity IDs from search_airports_cities. Useful for finding the cheapest dates before calling search_flights.

params.name: origin_entity_id
params.description: Google entity ID for the origin city/airport (e.g. '/m/022pfm' for São Paulo)

params.name: destination_entity_id
params.description: Google entity ID for the destination city/airport (e.g. '/m/06gmr' for Rio de Janeiro)

params.name: calendar_start
params.description: Start of the date range to show prices for (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: calendar_end
params.description: End of the date range to show prices for (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: csrf_token
params.description: Optional: 'at' anti-CSRF token from an active Google session

name: search_flights
description: Search for available flights. Returns options with prices, airlines, and schedules for the given route and dates. Use origin/destination entity IDs from search_airports_cities. Leave return_date empty for one-way.

params.name: origin_entity_id
params.description: Google entity ID for the origin city/airport (e.g. '/m/022pfm' for São Paulo)

params.name: destination_entity_id
params.description: Google entity ID for the destination city/airport (e.g. '/m/06gmr' for Rio de Janeiro)

params.name: return_date
params.description: Return date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty for a one-way search.

params.name: csrf_token
params.description: Optional: 'at' anti-CSRF token from an active Google session
